in_sanskrit.name: Bhawarlal
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who exists with the playful and delightful qualities of Bhava (existence) and Lalita (playful and delightful).

in_hindi.name: भावरलाल
in_hindi.long_meaning: भाव (existence) के साथ ललित (playful) रहने वाला

in_marathi.name: Bhawarlal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the World
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhawarlal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhawarlal is a compound name derived from Bhava, which means 'Lord' or 'God', and Rama, which means 'Lord of the World'. This name signifies the presence and power of the divine in an individual.
